scope: The original FPM library and pinned mctc-lib, multicharge, Jonquil and TOML-F dependencies are compiled with GNU Fortran 16.2.0 and pinned OpenBLAS. Jonquil and mctc-lib request different TOML-F tags; the operator recipe resolves both to the mctc-lib-requested 0.4.2 commit, checksummed in the dependency lock. The checked consumer adapts the upstream test_pbed4_mb01 reference and embeds MB16-43/01 geometry from mstore v0.4.0, retaining its Apache-2.0 attribution. PBE-D4 two-body energy is compared with -0.018578752883363366 Hartree to 1e-10 Hartree. It also checks finite results, zero net force, translation invariance and one analytical gradient component against a central finite difference with step 1e-5 bohr and tolerance 1e-6. Z denotes the physical dispersion model; no general-purpose differentiation or linear-system interface is inferred from its internal calculations. Other molecules, periodic systems, D4S, three-body terms and all gradients are outside this consumer verification scope. No numerical library source edits are applied; all dependencies use immutable shared archive exports. LGPL-3.0-or-later and dependency notices are retained.

initial_preparation_findings.conflicting_dependency_tags: Jonquil requests TOML-F v0.4.0; mctc-lib requests v0.4.2.
initial_preparation_findings.resolution: Pin TOML-F once at the v0.4.2 commit 51a26158c6d52bbc59cb482bdd13f00d7fd032a3.
